text:
Priya R.: kicking off — need a lean plan for the upcoming QBR with Northbridge. slides, ask list, and exec alignment 
Jorge M.: thanks — what's our ask tiering? are we doing silver/gold/exec lanes again? :thinking_face:
Alex C.: i'd keep it to 3 asks max for execs. Operational asks + 1 strategic ask.
Samira L.: onboarding status: 85% of seats provisioned, 2 integrations blocked by customer SSO. flagged as renewal risk if not resolved next week.
Devin (Enablement): I can run a 20m enablement before QBR to surface adoption wins. can we confirm slides by Wed? :calendar:
Priya R.: yes — deadline Wed EOD for slides. Jorge, can you own the renewal-risk slide and mitigation bullets?
Jorge M.: on it. i'll add a short playbook: SSO escalation steps, temporary token workaround, and timeline to resolution.
Samira L.: adding customer quote + usage graph to the onboarding slide. need raw metrics from Alex.
Alex C.: uploading snapshot to the deck and to the thread — link: https://redwood.docs/snapshots/northbridge-qbr-usage.png
Priya R.: nice. Devin — can you capture 2 enablement wins and 1 customer quote for the exec readout? keep it one sentence each.
Devin (Enablement): yep. will do. also will include training attendance and top 3 feature usage.
OnboardBot: Reminder — QBR dry run scheduled Thu 10:00. RSVP required.
Priya R.: dry run agenda: 1) 5m exec opening 2) 8m onboarding + adoption 3) 5m renewal risks & ask 4) 7m ops blockers + next steps 5) 5m Q&A
Jorge M.: for renewal ask — propose 12 month committed Dedicated plan. i'll include economic rationale and fallback (hosted with reserved burst).
Samira L.: risk note: licencing decision delayed by finance on their side. capturing in action items.
Alex C.: quick snippet for slides:
```
Action: Finance touchpoint by Fri
Owner: Samira
ETA: next Tue
```
Devin (Enablement): will run a 10m customer success story slide w/ before/after metrics. need the before numbers from Alex by Tue noon.
Priya R.: capture action items here. i'll convert to the project tracker after dry run.
Samira L.: Action: SSO escalation -> Owner: Jorge -> ETA: Mon COB
Jorge M.: Action: renewal ask draft -> Owner: Jorge -> ETA: Tue EOD
Alex C.: Action: usage snapshot + before numbers -> Owner: Alex -> ETA: Tue noon
Devin (Enablement): Action: enablement wins + quote -> Owner: Devin -> ETA: Wed noon
Priya R.: one more — feedback capture: we need to log customer's top 3 asks into Product feedback board. Devin, can you capture during dry run?
Devin (Enablement): yes. will add to product.redwood/feedback with tags: northbridge,qbr,renewal
Priya R.: great. final ask — anyone able to join exec pre-brief 30m before the QBR? (Priya + Jorge prefer yes)
Alex C.: i can join the pre-brief.
Samira L.: i'll join.
Jorge M.: i'll be there.
Priya R.: perfect. i'll update the deck with slides we discussed and ping again after dry run. please react with :thumbsup: when you see the updated deck.
Devin (Enablement): noted. will prepare a 1-slide script for the exec readout.
OnboardBot: RSVP update: 6 participants confirmed.
Priya R.: thanks team — moving this to the QBR channel once deck is stable. any last quick blockers?
Alex C.: nothing else from infra side.
Samira L.: raising a minor ask: customer wants a short walkthrough video. can we have a trimmed 3m clip?
Devin (Enablement): yes — i'll draft it after enablement win bullets are final. ETA Wed EOD for draft video.
Priya R.: awesome. last_message_by Priya R. — closing thread until deck update.
